scope: Synthetic simple variants and public HG002 chr20 only; no patient execution
source_note: Installed package info/git reports v1.2.0-20-g928b9bd; this is not the v1.2.0 tag. Help and source defaults also differ.
settings_basis: Use built-in case-only germline mode. Explicit coverage 100, assembly rounds 3 and LOD 8 reproduce actual build-source defaults, rather than conflicting help defaults.
germline_effects_from_source: Set nm rule [3,0], which pinned SeqLib interprets as outside inclusive [0,3], therefore NM>=4 for nonnegative NM
metadata_correction: The first synthetic run copied the help claim NM>=3 into this description. Review of pinned SeqLib 534c657496a203e9ad6dd959d7c9c41e2b123afd corrected the boundary to NM>=4. The executed common_options are unchanged, and the original synthetic configuration is preserved with that run.
synthetic_region: Entire three-chromosome fictional reference, including unchanged chromosome 3
public_region: Entire chr20; benchmark against the same complete official GIAB v5.0q chr20 BED as DELLY
output_policy: Retain filtered and unfiltered SV and indel VCFs, assembly contigs, breakpoint table and native logs. Validate and account for paired BNDs before a combined DEL/INS comparison.
limitations: Single-case germline settings reduce interchromosomal lookup; no translocation sensitivity claim
No optional dbSNP, simple-repeat or blacklist input
Prealigned public chr20 tests a caller component, not the patient raw-read workflow
Do not tune these settings to public benchmark outcomes
